# Alsyed Jalal AI

> Alsyed Jalal AI is a web-based workspace for local utilities, optional provider-backed text assistance, learning and records. Availability differs by feature and deployment.

The AI Hub contains curated prompt and skill references; these are not separate autonomous AI agents. The Media Studio can edit photos and trim short videos locally in supported browsers, without uploading the selected files or requiring sign-in. It does not generate images or videos with AI.

A visible interface or configured provider is not proof that a live request, login or database workflow succeeds. Some features need a functioning application server, database and provider; their state must be checked independently. The selected voice and browser speech features depend on device capabilities.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/): An introduction to the workspace and its available tools.
- [AI Hub](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/ai-hub): Local tools, provider availability and curated prompt references.
- [Media Studio](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/media-studio): Browser-based photo editing and short-video trimming with explicit format limits.
- [Meet JARVIS](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/about-jarvis): An overview of the voice and text assistant and its limitations.
- [Intelligence evolution](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/intelligence-evolution): An educational comparison of AI, generative AI, AGI, ASI and organic intelligence.
- [Learning roadmaps](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/roadmaps): Learning paths and progress stored on the user's device.
- [Visual styles](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/visual-styles): An overview of workspace design themes.

## Site discovery

- [Sitemap](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Public canonical pages for search engines.
- [Robots policy](https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/robots.txt): Crawler access and sitemap location.
